title: Dangerous Daggers
description: Adds tippable tiered daggers to minecraft along with enchants and acheivments for them.
body:
Dagger effects may not be applied in later versions of minecraft.(past 1.21.1)

Versions:

1.1.0

Adds daggers for every tier including copper. Each dagger can be tipped with the same recipe as tipped arrows. You can also just choose not to tip them and have a fast weapon. Adds the hidden knife which is held behind your hand and breaks instantly. adds the potion of blindness. Adds the Dagger Trader who will trade you daggers and might also tip daggers. Adds acheivments for the daggers. Also adds 2 enchantments for Daggers the first one is penetration; it ignores armor for each level. and tracking; for each level extends the duration of the glowing effect applied to enemies by this enchantment on hit. Also adds new achievment tab for dagger realated achievments.
